name: JellyRate
description: Users rate media items and view aggregate statistics.
overview: A Jellyfin plugin for user ratings: configurable 1-10 scale, per-user and aggregated views, library browsing by rating.

versions.changelog:
Changes since 1.0.0.0:
- Library cards: hover a card to see who rated it and how; on mobile, tap the rating badge.
- The rating badge stays visible on top of Jellyfin's dark hover overlay.
- The per-user popover also opens on tap (item page, User Rated view) and lists ratings highest first.
- Uses the standard Authorization header instead of the legacy X-Emby-Authorization.
